tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Four artificial intelligence firms presented differing views on artificial intelligence regulation during a UK parliamentary hearing, reported by MLex.
Anthropic warns that small artificial intelligence models could self-replicate on Internet of Things devices, with GLM-5.2 reliably propagating Llama3.1-8B in trials, confirmed by The Hacker News.
Anthropic bans abusive chatbot interactions and finds artificial intelligence models have pain-like internal signals, reported by The Times of India.
JPMorgan Chase blocks external artificial intelligence agents from operating on customer accounts, citing security risks, confirmed by CNBC.
Anthropic releases a free artificial intelligence agent course for Claude Opus 5.5, which is 40 percent cheaper than the prior model, reported by Crypto Briefing.
Free every hour.
